row.evidence: Doppler's pricing page lists "Enterprise SCIM" only on the Custom-priced Enterprise plan, and the docs say "SAML SSO is available with our Team plan while SCIM is exclusive to our Enterprise plan."
row.notes: Unchanged from June: SAML SSO on Team ($21/user/mo), SCIM only on Enterprise (Custom pricing). Doppler bills per seat per month; no annual price is listed. Developer is free for 3 users then $8/mo per additional user. SCIM needs an existing SAML app and a verified domain; IdP guides cover Okta, Entra ID, OneLogin, JumpCloud, Duo and Authentik, all using custom/non-gallery apps (the Okta OIN app is SAML-only). Doppler has no suspended-user state, so deprovisioning removes the user. User groups are Enterprise or a $9/seat/mo Team add-on. June's third-party Enterprise estimate is dropped (no first-party source).

plans.price_text: Free for 3 users, $8/mo per additional user

plans.notes: Pricing FAQ says Doppler charges per seat per month; no annual rate is published. Custom roles, user groups and extra syncs are $9/seat/mo add-ons.

auth.token_source: Team > SSO > SCIM 2.0 > Manage, then Tokens > SCIM > Roll
auth.notes: Token format dp.scim.*; rolling a token invalidates the old one. The JumpCloud guide uses a 'Basic Auth Header' value from the same page.

endpoints.notes: JumpCloud guide calls the /users endpoint path; groups are created by Okta Push Groups. Discovery endpoints are not documented.

operations.notes: Okta 'Update User Attributes' is enabled but the PUT vs PATCH method is not documented.

deprovision.notes: Doppler has no suspended state; IdPs should delete the user. Whether the seat frees immediately and what data is kept is not documented.

pagination.notes: startIndex/count paging per the JumpCloud guide.

attributes.notes: Only the attributes the IdP guides map: username = email, name (first + last), email. No published SCIM schema; group attributes inferred from Okta push-group behaviour (name + members).

roles.how: IdP groups are pushed as Doppler groups, which are then granted project roles; the workplace role for new users is a default set in Doppler.

rate_limits.text: Doppler API limits vary by plan (Enterprise 480 reads/min, 240 writes/min); SCIM-specific limits not stated.

limitations.text: Entra ID provisioning syncs at fixed 40-minute intervals after the initial cycle.
Requires a verified domain and an existing SAML application.
No suspend support; IdPs must delete users rather than suspend them.

auth.notes: Personal, CLI, service account, SCIM and read-only Audit tokens; no OAuth scopes.

capabilities.notes: Workplace Users API exposes List, Retrieve and Update (role change) only; no create/remove user endpoint is documented. Invites can be listed.

endpoints.purpose: Update a workplace user's workplace role

audit_log_api.notes: Activity Logs API; retention is 3 days (Developer), 90 days (Team), custom (Enterprise).

rate_limits.text: Per plan: Developer 240 reads/60 writes per min, Team 480/120, Enterprise 480/240; 429 on limit.

limitations.text: No documented endpoint to create or remove a workplace user.

okta.notes: OIN app shows only SAML checked (rendered page). Doppler's SCIM guide adds SCIM to a custom Okta SAML app instead.

entra.notes: No Entra gallery tutorial found (doppler-tutorial 404); Doppler documents a custom SAML enterprise app with SCIM provisioning.

google.notes: Custom Google SAML app; no Google SCIM guide.

onelogin.notes: Uses OneLogin's generic 'SCIM Provisioner with SAML (SCIM v2 Core)' app.

jumpcloud.notes: Uses JumpCloud's Custom API identity-management connector against Doppler's SCIM base URI.

fallbacks.other_sync: Email SSO self-registration for verified domains
fallbacks.notes: SAML users get a default workplace role 'when their account is created', implying SAML account creation, but JIT is not named explicitly.
